title: Check yourself: The gateway, budgets and callers that cannot wait

questions.stem: Scenario: Oriel Telecom's legacy billing system can call only synchronous endpoints and times out after two seconds, but the task needs long reasoning that takes about twenty. What design fits best?

options.text: Cut the reasoning short, so that the answer arrives before the legacy timeout expires
options.says: Ruled out because "truncating the work sacrifices the task".

options.text: Ask the platform team to raise the legacy timeout to thirty seconds for this one job
options.says: Ruled out because the timeout "is often not yours to change", and raising it moves the problem into a system nobody owns.

options.text: Accept the job, hand back a ticket number at once, and deliver the outcome afterwards
options.says: Accept-and-poll decouples submission from delivery, so the limit and the work coexist.

options.text: Move the task to the smallest available model, which answers quickly enough to fit
options.says: Ruled out because "A faster model may not exist for the quality needed".

questions.stem: Scenario: Pylon Software's four teams each hold a separate key, and finance cannot say which team spent what. The platform team proposes an internal gateway. What will the gateway achieve by itself?

options.text: A smaller token bill for each team, since every request now passes one central point
options.says: Ruled out because the savings "come from caching, the choice of model and batching" and not from the gateway.

options.text: One place for credentials, routes, budgets and usage records, since all traffic passes it
options.says: A gateway is a control point for credentials, routing, budgets and usage records.

options.text: Faster answers on every call, since the gateway adds capacity of its own to the model
options.says: Ruled out because a gateway does not "Make a model faster" and adds no capacity of its own.

options.text: Better answers on every call, since the gateway rewrites the prompts it forwards
options.says: Ruled out because it does not "Remove the need to evaluate a model for a task", and it does not rewrite prompts.
